Who it’s for

The people who carry other people, and rarely get a teacher of their own. The app’s library already has a program set for each.

ConsciousOS is a practice companion, not medical or mental-health treatment, and it does not replace professional care.

A companion that meets you wherever you are

You do not climb a ladder here. You walk a spiral, passing familiar ground with more depth each time. The app walks beside you, and slowly steps back.

    In a spiral, you visit the same place twice. Depth is greater.

    Deep tech, applied to the inner life

    ConsciousOS is not a chatbot with incense. It is a research-driven system: a psychometric of our own, a real-time engine stack, and a closed loop that learns from every session.

    From research to your session

    1. Lineage researchClassical sources on the four paths, read and structured, not summarised.
    2. A psychometric model11 bands, 33 sub-stages and six dimensions, with math that punishes imbalance.
    3. A real-time engine stackEngines that compose, adapt and detect patterns on every turn.
    4. Your sessionAssembled seconds ago from your state, then scored to improve the next one.
    consciousness-engine / vlevel
    
      
    One collapsed dimension drags the whole score. That is deliberate: the math enforces balance, so the app cannot reward insight that has outrun embodiment.

      For organisations: care at scale, without surveillance
      
  
      Companies and public services run on people under pressure. ConsciousOS gives each person a private companion, and gives the organisation a view of patterns, never of individuals.
      
  
      
    
      The employee
      Owns their data
      Opts in to each signal separately and sees their own patterns first.
      
    
      The manager
      Gets private coaching
      Feedback on their own patterns. Not a dossier on the people they lead.
      
    
      The organisation
      Sees anonymised trends
      Which loops are rising across teams, not who has them.

      What we track
      
  
      ConsciousOS keeps a living model of you on two axes, plus the patterns, domains and energies that shape each day. It exists so the next session fits you.
      
  
      
    
      
      
      Two axes: V-Level and H-Level
      
        
      V-Level is the vertical stage. H-Level is 12 capacities that grow independently across it. Two people at the same V-Level can have different shapes, so they get different practices.
      
        
      
    
      V-Level: 11 bands, one continuous number
      The integer is your band. The fraction is your micro-level. Tap a band.
      
      
        
      
        EnteringDeepeningMastery
        
        
        under 0.3
        more support        0.3 to 0.7
        more autonomy        0.7 and up
        you lead
        
  
        
  
        

        


        


        


        
  
        Our engines and the AI brain
        
  
        One snapshot of you feeds every engine. Every session writes back to it, so the next one is a little more accurate. The system is built to be needed less over time.
        
  
        
    
        
    
        
      
        One snapshot, every engine
        
      
        A single function, getUserContext(), gathers everything the system knows right now and hands the same picture to each engine. That is why they stay coherent.
        
      
        
      
        Because the loop closes, the app gets more accurate every day, and its voice fades as you grow. We call that graceful disappearance.
        
    
        
  
        
  
        

        


        


        


        
  
        Ancient maps, modern lenses
        
  
        Yoga and the Upanishads asked what a self is, what reality is, and who is aware of both. Modern science asks versions of the same questions. We hold the two side by side, as lenses and not as proofs.
        
  
        
    
        
    
        
  
        
  
        
    
        Where much of this inquiry was developed
        
      
        Many of the earliest systematic maps of consciousness were drawn in India and then travelled across Asia. We also draw on Greek, Sufi and Chinese voices, because the question belongs to everyone.
        
      
        UpanishadsSamkhyaYoga SutrasAdvaitaTantraBuddhism
        
    
        Lenses, not proofs
        
      
        We do not claim that physics confirms Brahman, or that we live in a simulation. Those questions are open. The parallels are useful maps, you never need to believe any of them, and every idea in the app is something you can test in your own attention.
        
  
        

        


        


        


        
  
        From the first yogi to the device in your hand
        
  
        Yoga is one of the oldest continuous inner sciences. This is the short story of how it travelled, and why we built ConsciousOS to carry it forward.
        
  
        
  
        
  
        
  
        From one man in stillness to a quiet companion in your pocket. The goal has never changed: you, needing it less.
        
  
        Dates in the early periods come from tradition and are debated by scholars. We tell them as an origin story, not a calendar.
